requirements.title: Run the mandatory integrated learner journeys
Bound security and persistence release gates
Complete accessible behavior, not CSS presence
Publish only the qualified audience and artifacts
State exact completion and remaining work

cases.name: Deliver dependency-ordered vertical slices
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Build a dependency graph from delivered slice receipts S0-S5.
Check each consumer's input contract hash matches its producer and any amended contract reran affected cases.
expected: Every dependency is satisfied at a matching contract revision before acceptance; stale consumers block the slice.

cases.name: Produce installable profile artifacts
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Install each profile in a clean user-owned virtual environment from its delivered lock.
Run package consistency, imports and startup; disable network after approved preparation and execute its required path.
expected: All dependencies are hash-pinned; correct CPU/cu126 Torch selected; no global install; offline required paths operate without network.

cases.name: Freeze candidate and acceptance denominator
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Freeze requirement/case and candidate manifests.
Expand every case×profile and every browser-case engine; inject one BLOCKED case and calculate release eligibility.
Change one implementation, lock, model, contract, fixture or registry byte and create the replacement candidate.
expected: Counts equal the full expanded registry; the injected BLOCKED result prevents release; no case disappears.
Every mandatory execution row on the replacement candidate is NOT_RUN; historical PASS rows do not qualify it.

cases.name: Keep verification stages separate
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Inspect stage receipts and raw test outputs.
Attempt to use simulated or source-only evidence for a required native/model/browser case.
expected: All six stages retain distinct statuses; a substitute for native evidence is rejected and the case remains NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.

cases.name: Define executable acceptance evidence
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Create PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN rows and two attempts of one failing case.
Verify fresh output paths, file hashes and required row fields; scan exported reports for forbidden credential fields.
expected: Every required field/hash resolves; failed attempts remain; missing output or credentials in reports fail acceptance.

cases.name: J1 Foundation continuity
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Execute DEL-006 J1 in Edge and Firefox from separate fresh browser profiles.
expected: Read/practice/self-check survive reload/export/import; no artifact or assessor verification is awarded.

cases.name: Bound security and persistence release gates
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Execute each listed adversarial and persistence fault in isolated fixtures.
Compare registry/job counts and protected hashes before and after rejected attempts; verify child process ownership.
expected: No unauthorized job/state mutation or unrelated process termination; committed artifacts keep their recorded digests; every job that did not complete is failed or interrupted with its terminal_reason, and storage_writable false puts the service in read-only recovery with mutations returning STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE.

cases.name: Complete accessible behavior, not CSS presence
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Run each named native accessibility condition in both browsers.
Record applicable WCAG criteria; attempt to substitute a CSS audit for a keyboard or screen-reader journey.
expected: Both engines pass required behavior/criteria; source-only substitution cannot mark behavioral tests PASS.

cases.name: Publish only the qualified audience and artifacts
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Inspect qualified distributions and publication identity; verify existing audience.
Exercise supported storage rollback from retained backup; attempt destructive downgrade.
expected: Published/installable bytes match qualified source; audience is preserved; unsupported destructive downgrade is refused.

cases.name: State exact completion and remaining work
preconditions: Frozen implementation candidate, specification registry, isolated test storage and profile receipt.
steps: Join delivered requirement coverage, case/profile results and custody checks.
Produce a final report that distinguishes document, product, browser, delivery and learner statuses.
expected: No requirement/case/profile/browser is unaccounted for; any missing evidence keeps product readiness incomplete.

cases.name: J2 Real tiny experiment
preconditions: Frozen candidate and empty isolated profile storage; paired local runtime; native browser access.
steps: Execute the exact named journey in DEL-006 in both specified browser engines.
Retain action/observation trace and artifact/checkpoint/job identities.
expected: Actual local training/evaluation/generation artifacts and identity-linked notes exist; no recorded fixture substitutes execution.

cases.name: J3 Interruption and recovery
preconditions: Frozen candidate and empty isolated profile storage; paired local runtime; native browser access.
steps: Execute the exact named journey in DEL-006 in both specified browser engines.
Retain action/observation trace and artifact/checkpoint/job identities.
expected: The cancelled job is interrupted with terminal_reason user_cancelled and keeps its checkpoint_id; after service restart a job that was nonterminal is interrupted with reason service_restarted; resume creates exactly one child run and no duplicate job.

cases.name: J4 Applied adaptation
preconditions: Frozen candidate and empty isolated profile storage; paired local runtime; native browser access.
steps: Execute the exact named journey in DEL-006 in both specified browser engines.
Retain action/observation trace and artifact/checkpoint/job identities.
expected: The baseline and adapter evaluations name the same evaluation_profile_id and dataset digest in one paired artifact; base-file SHA-256 digests are equal before and after training; adapter tensors differ from their initial values; each output shows its model_id and, for the adapter, adapter_checkpoint_id.

cases.name: J5 Portable reuse
preconditions: Frozen candidate and empty isolated profile storage; paired local runtime; native browser access.
steps: Execute the exact named journey in DEL-006 in both specified browser engines.
Retain action/observation trace and artifact/checkpoint/job identities.
expected: Validated bundle imports in clean root, loads and runs with permitted output agreement and imported provenance.

cases.name: J6 Bad-input recovery
preconditions: Frozen candidate and empty isolated profile storage; paired local runtime; native browser access.
steps: Execute the exact named journey in DEL-006 in both specified browser engines.
Retain action/observation trace and artifact/checkpoint/job identities.
expected: Every bad input in the J6 chain is rejected with its contract code; prior valid records and notes remain byte-identical; each rejection message names the rejected field or artifact ID and a corrective action (06-APPLIED-MODELS.md error rule); and an export of the surviving state validates.

cases.name: J7 Native accessible local journeys
preconditions: Frozen candidate and empty isolated profile storage; paired local runtime; native browser access.
steps: Execute the exact named journey in DEL-006 in both specified browser engines.
Retain action/observation trace and artifact/checkpoint/job identities.
expected: Every DEL-008 matrix condition passes for the J2 principal actions and the J4 input/output reading in Edge and in Firefox (keyboard-only, NVDA, 360px, 200% text, 400% zoom, reduced motion, forced colors, chart tables).

cases.name: Required-preset fit calibration on reference machines
preconditions: The profile's lockfile is installed on a reference machine (x86_64, at least 16 GiB RAM, at least four logical cores); the pinned model is prepared; the storage root is clean.
steps: Freeze subchecks AC-DEL-017.<profile>.<operation>.<preset-or-configuration> from every required role in contracts/evidence-verification.md for FOUNDATION-12, CUR-005 to CUR-012, CUR-014 and CUR-015.

Run each pair once with exactly the prescribed settings; record wall time from starting to terminal, peak worker resident memory, peak reserved CUDA memory on win-cuda and wsl-cuda, terminal state and committed artifact digests.

With the shortened-clock deadline test mechanism, stop the 40-update smollm2-intents-lora-v1 adapter_train at a durable checkpoint before update 40, resume it to update 40, run the 20-update resume, and verify module 17.
expected: Every pair completes within 30 minutes with peak resident memory at most 12 GiB; model_prepare registers within 5 minutes of its last byte.
Any pair outside either bound blocks qualification, and the failed record is retained; no prescribed step count, seed, dataset or cadence differs from the specification.
The resumed chain satisfies check intermediate-adapter-comparison-v1.006, and the timeout screen offers the same-settings retry without changing the update count.
On win-cuda and wsl-cuda every pair also keeps peak reserved CUDA memory at most 1,536 MiB.
